{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check all QA orders (revenue = '999999.99')
qa_full = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Total QA orders in full dataset: {len(qa_full)}')
print(f'QA orders status: {qa_full["status"].unique().tolist()}')
print(f'QA orders customer_segment: {qa_full["customer_segment"].unique().tolist()}')

# Now check completed-only
completed_only = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
qa_in_completed = completed_only[completed_only['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'QA orders in completed set: {len(qa_in_completed)}')

# Check their status
print(f'QA orders in completed set have status: {qa_in_completed["status"].unique().tolist()}')"}
